context: A teacher walks a teen through politics research
purpose: Teach: 与野党/惨敗/屈折/コレステロール/ステロイド/草の根/転向/撃つ

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、戦後の、本気で、絶対、与野党、絶対、論争、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Sakura, your paper on the postwar ruling and opposition party debate was genuinely impressive.
lines.style: Warm, measured acknowledgment. Slight lift on Sakura's name—personal recognition. Steady pace, genuine appreciation in the tone. The ease of a teacher speaking to a student who has clearly done serious work.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。選挙の、本気で、絶対、惨敗、絶対、後の、絶対、再建、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I really focused on how the parties rebuilt themselves after the election defeat.
lines.style: Respectful but present. Not overly formal—she's comfortable with this teacher. Quiet conviction in her voice. A slight lean forward in the delivery, showing genuine investment in the topic.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 歴史認識の、本気で、絶対、屈折、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で、感心
lines.en: The way you handled the complexity of historical consciousness in that period—really thoughtful.
lines.style: Reflective, almost thinking aloud. Deliberate pacing. Recognition landing softly but genuinely. The tone of someone who has read closely and wants the student to know she noticed the depth.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。食生活と、本気で、絶対、コレステロール、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I also explored how diet and cholesterol became a public concern during that time.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, clear. No apology for the topic shift. She's stating her research terrain calmly, with quiet confidence. Direct eye contact implied in the delivery.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: スポーツの、本気で、絶対、ステロイド、絶対、問題、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: And the steroid abuse problem in sports—you wove that in with real nuance.
lines.style: Engaged, nodding slightly in the voice. Recognition of a well-chosen secondary thread. Warm but precise. The pacing suggests she's genuinely connecting with the scope of Sakura's thinking.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。市民運動の、本気で、絶対、草の根、絶対、活動、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Right. I wanted to show how grassroots citizen movements shaped the conversation.
lines.style: Steady, articulate. She's explaining her choices, not defending them. Slight emphasis on 'wanted'—showing agency in her research decisions. Calm confidence underneath.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦後思想の、本気で、絶対、転向、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The ideological shifts in postwar thought that you documented—that was the strongest thread.
lines.style: Reflective, almost admiringly. Slower pacing on 'documented.' The delivery carries weight—this is the moment of real recognition. Genuine warmth, no performance.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。歴史的に、本気で、絶対、銃を、絶対、撃つ、絶対、行為と、絶対、社会、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes, especially the relationship between historical violence and how society reckons with it.
lines.style: Careful, intentional delivery. Precise word choice audible in the tone. She's not rushing this final point. Quiet gravity—she understands the weight of what she's discussing. Present and clear.
